correctness.rationale: Over arbitrary R, in the decomposition R⊕V_R the unital map fixing scalars is triangular with scalar diagonal 1 and vector block T, so is invertible exactly when T is. Multiplicativity on V_R is equivalent to vanishing of both scalar and vector parts of the product of two images. With β=α∘T⁻¹ the vector equation is β(u)z+β(z)u=0, and taking distinct basis vectors kills both coefficients without division or reducedness. Thus for rank at least two composition is just composition of invertible linear maps. In rank one the image a+bε has square a²+2abε, giving a²=0 and 2a=0 since b is invertible. The resulting scheme is G_m outside characteristic two; in characteristic two its reduction a=0 is a subgroup of dimension one and at the identity the two classes a and b−1 survive modulo the square of the maximal ideal. The tangent dimension is two and smoothness fails. In characteristic two, for clarity, φ_(a,b)∘φ_(c,d) has coordinates (c+da,db); the coordinate scheme does not assert a direct-product group law. This coefficient proof also validates the verification note without any computational certificate.

value.rationale: The short arbitrary-base proof is a useful illustrative example of infinitesimal structure invisible over fields, but as a separate finding it adds only a direct parameter specialization of the full coordinate-cross theorem and the immediate tangent calculation for its displayed coordinate ring. There is no distinct motivated invariant, counterexample outside that theorem, or additional classification left to accept as a standalone result. It can serve as an example of the broader result, not a repaired independent finding.
